label: D&D 5e
description: Dungeons & Dragons, 5th Edition — the classic fantasy TTRPG.
tldr: D&D 5e (2014) — a d20 fantasy RPG using six ability scores, proficiency bonuses, saving throws, skills, and class features. Characters advance through 20 levels, with subclasses providing additional specialization.

races.Human: Adaptable and ambitious, humans are the most widespread of the common peoples.
races.Elf: Graceful and long-lived, elves combine keen senses with an affinity for magic, art, and ancient traditions.
races.Dwarf: Stout and resilient, dwarves are renowned for endurance, craftsmanship, and loyalty.
races.Halfling: Small, nimble, and fortunate, halflings thrive through community, courage, and uncanny luck.
races.Dragonborn: Proud draconic humanoids whose ancestry manifests through a breath weapon and elemental resistance.
races.Gnome: Small, clever, and curious folk with an affinity for magic, invention, and illusion.
races.Half-Elf: Children of two worlds, half-elves combine elven senses with human versatility and social adaptability.
races.Half-Orc: Powerful and enduring, half-orcs combine human and orc heritage with formidable martial resilience.
races.Tiefling: Humanoids marked by fiendish ancestry, possessing innate magic and resistance to fire.

classes.Barbarian: A fierce warrior who channels rage into exceptional durability and devastating melee attacks.
classes.Bard: A versatile spellcaster whose magic flows through performance, inspiration, lore, and words.
classes.Cleric: A divine spellcaster who channels the power of a deity or divine force to heal, protect, and destroy.
classes.Druid: A primal spellcaster devoted to nature, able to call on elemental magic and transform into beasts.
classes.Fighter: A versatile martial specialist with exceptional weapon and armor proficiency and repeated attacks.
classes.Monk: A disciplined martial artist who uses speed, unarmed strikes, and ki to perform extraordinary techniques.
classes.Paladin: A holy warrior whose sacred oath grants divine magic, healing, protection, and empowered attacks.
classes.Ranger: A wilderness warrior specializing in tracking, exploration, ranged combat, and fighting favored foes.
classes.Rogue: A skilled specialist who combines expertise, stealth, cunning actions, and precise Sneak Attacks.
classes.Sorcerer: A spontaneous spellcaster whose magic comes from an innate magical origin and is shaped with Metamagic.
classes.Warlock: A spellcaster empowered by a pact with an otherworldly patron, supplemented by eldritch invocations.
classes.Wizard: A scholarly arcane spellcaster who learns and prepares spells from a spellbook.

Barbarian.name: Path of the Berserker
Barbarian.description: A barbarian who embraces an especially furious combat style.

Barbarian.name: Path of the Totem Warrior
Barbarian.description: A barbarian who draws spiritual power from animal totems.

Bard.name: College of Lore
Bard.description: A bard devoted to gathering knowledge and broadening magical versatility.

Bard.name: College of Valor
Bard.description: A bard who inspires allies through martial prowess and heroic example.

Cleric.name: Life Domain
Cleric.description: A cleric devoted to healing, vitality, and the preservation of life.

Cleric.name: War Domain
Cleric.description: A cleric who serves a deity associated with war, conquest, or martial strength.

Cleric.name: Trickery Domain
Cleric.description: A cleric whose divine gifts emphasize deception, stealth, and misdirection.

Druid.name: Circle of the Moon
Druid.description: A druid specialized in powerful combat Wild Shape forms.

Druid.name: Circle of the Land
Druid.description: A druid whose magic is deeply connected to a chosen natural environment.

Fighter.name: Champion
Fighter.description: A straightforward martial archetype focused on reliable weapon attacks and physical excellence.

Fighter.name: Battle Master
Fighter.description: A tactical fighter who uses superiority dice and maneuvers to control combat.

Fighter.name: Eldritch Knight
Fighter.description: A fighter who combines weapon mastery with a limited selection of wizard spells.

Monk.name: Way of the Open Hand
Monk.description: A martial tradition centered on unarmed technique and manipulation of an opponent's body.

Monk.name: Way of Shadow
Monk.description: A monk tradition using stealth, darkness, and supernatural mobility.

Monk.name: Way of the Four Elements
Monk.description: A monk tradition that channels elemental disciplines through ki.

Paladin.name: Oath of Devotion
Paladin.description: A paladin sworn to honesty, courage, compassion, and duty.

Paladin.name: Oath of the Ancients
Paladin.description: A paladin sworn to protect life, beauty, hope, and the light of the natural world.

Paladin.name: Oath of Vengeance
Paladin.description: A paladin committed to pursuing and defeating grave evils.

Ranger.name: Hunter
Ranger.description: A ranger specializing in selecting combat techniques suited to different prey.

Ranger.name: Beast Master
Ranger.description: A ranger who forms a close bond with an animal companion.

Rogue.name: Thief
Rogue.description: A rogue focused on speed, climbing, using objects, and exploiting magic items.

Rogue.name: Assassin
Rogue.description: A rogue specializing in infiltration, disguise, poison, and devastating surprise attacks.

Rogue.name: Arcane Trickster
Rogue.description: A rogue who combines stealth and legerdemain with illusion and enchantment magic.

Sorcerer.name: Draconic Bloodline
Sorcerer.description: A sorcerer whose innate magic comes from a draconic ancestry.

Sorcerer.name: Wild Magic
Sorcerer.description: A sorcerer whose magic is infused with unpredictable arcane chaos.

Warlock.name: The Fiend
Warlock.description: A warlock bound to a fiendish patron and empowered by infernal or abyssal forces.

Warlock.name: The Great Old One
Warlock.description: A warlock whose patron is an incomprehensible entity from beyond ordinary reality.

Wizard.name: School of Evocation
Wizard.description: A wizard specializing in elemental and forceful spells that can be shaped around allies.

Wizard.name: School of Abjuration
Wizard.description: A wizard specializing in protective magic, wards, and magical defense.

Wizard.name: School of Illusion
Wizard.description: A wizard specializing in illusions and manipulating perception.

trait_details.Skill Versatility: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.
trait_details.Speed: 30 feet: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.
trait_details.Languages: Common, Elvish, and one extra: You speak, read, and write Common and Elvish, plus one extra language of your choice.

trait_details.Ability Score Increase: +2 Strength, +1: Your Strength increases by 2 and Constitution by 1.
trait_details.Darkvision: You see in dim light within 60 feet as bright light and darkness as dim light, without color in darkness.
trait_details.Relentless Endurance: When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead; once per long rest.
trait_details.Savage Attacks: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, roll one additional weapon damage die.
trait_details.Speed: 30 feet: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.
trait_details.Languages: Common and Orc: You speak, read, and write Common and Orc.

trait_details.Ability Score Increase: +2 Charisma, +1: Your Charisma increases by 2 and Intelligence by 1.
trait_details.Darkvision: You see in dim light within 60 feet as bright light and darkness as dim light, without color in darkness.
trait_details.Hellish Resistance: You have resistance to fire damage.
trait_details.Infernal Legacy: You know thaumaturgy; at 3rd level you can cast hellish rebuke once per long rest, and at 5th level darkness once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.
trait_details.Speed: 30 feet: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

trait_details.Ability Score Increase: +2 Dexterity, +1: Your Dexterity increases by 2 and Wisdom by 1.
trait_details.Flight: You have a flying speed of 50 feet. You can't fly while wearing medium or heavy armor.

trait_details.Darkvision: You see in dim light within 60 feet as bright light and darkness as dim light, without color in darkness.
trait_details.Fury of the Small: When you damage a creature larger than you, you can deal extra damage equal to your level once per short or long rest.
trait_details.Nimble Escape: You can Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

trait_details.Ability Score Increase: +2 Dexterity, +1: Your Dexterity increases by 2 and Charisma by 1.
trait_details.Darkvision: You see in dim light within 60 feet as bright light and darkness as dim light, without color in darkness.
trait_details.Feline Agility: When you move on your turn, you can double your speed until the end of the turn; you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.
trait_details.Cat's Claws: Your claws are natural weapons dealing 1d4 slashing damage, and you have a climbing speed of 20 feet.
trait_details.Cat's Talents: You have proficiency in Perception and Stealth.
trait_details.Speed: 30 feet: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.
trait_details.Languages: Common and one extra language: You speak Common and one other language of your choice.

trait_details.Elf Weapon Training: You gain proficiency with longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.
trait_details.Cantrip: You know one cantrip from the wizard spell list; Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.
trait_details.Extra Language: You can speak, read, and write one additional language.

trait_details.Elf Weapon Training: You gain proficiency with longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.
trait_details.Fleet of Foot: Your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.
trait_details.Mask of the Wild: You can attempt to hide when lightly obscured by natural phenomena.

trait_details.Superior Darkvision: Your darkvision has a range of 120 feet.
trait_details.Sunlight Sensitivity: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight while in direct sunlight.
trait_details.Drow Magic: You know dancing lights; at 3rd level you can cast faerie fire once per long rest, and at 5th level darkness once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.
trait_details.Drow Weapon Training: You gain proficiency with rapiers, shortswords, and hand crossbows.

trait_details.Dwarven Toughness: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

trait_details.Dwarven Armor Training: You gain proficiency with light and medium armor.

trait_details.Naturally Stealthy: You can attempt to hide even when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.

trait_details.Stout Resilience: You have advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage.

trait_details.Natural Illusionist: You know the minor illusion cantrip; Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.
trait_details.Speak with Small Beasts: You can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts.

trait_details.Artificer's Lore: When making an Intelligence (History) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, you add twice your proficiency bonus.
trait_details.Tinker: You have proficiency with tinker's tools and can construct small clockwork devices.

feature_details.Rage: As a bonus action, enter a rage for up to 1 minute. While raging you gain bonus melee damage, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and advantage on Strength checks and saves; you cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
feature_details.Unarmored Defense: While not wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier.
feature_details.Reckless Attack: On your first attack of the turn using Strength, you can gain advantage on Strength-based melee weapon attack rolls for the turn, while attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.
feature_details.Danger Sense: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects you can see, such as traps and spells.
feature_details.Extra Attack: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
feature_details.Fast Movement: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.
feature_details.Feral Instinct: You have advantage on initiative rolls; if surprised, you can act normally on your first turn by entering your rage first.
feature_details.Brutal Critical (1 die): When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, roll one additional weapon damage die.
feature_details.Brutal Critical (2 dice): Your Brutal Critical feature rolls two additional weapon damage dice.
feature_details.Brutal Critical (3 dice): Your Brutal Critical feature rolls three additional weapon damage dice.
feature_details.Relentless Rage: If you drop to 0 hit points while raging, you can make a Constitution saving throw to drop to 1 hit point instead.
feature_details.Persistent Rage: Your rage ends early only if you fall unconscious or choose to end it.
feature_details.Indomitable Might: If your total for a Strength check is less than your Strength score, you can use your Strength score instead.
feature_details.Primal Champion: Your Strength and Constitution scores each increase by 4, and their maximums become 24.
feature_details.Spellcasting: You gain the ability to cast spells using the class's spellcasting rules, spell list, spell slots, and spellcasting ability.
feature_details.Bardic Inspiration (d6): As a bonus action, grant a creature within 60 feet a d6 it can add to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw within the next 10 minutes.
feature_details.Jack of All Trades: Add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.
feature_details.Song of Rest (d6): During a short rest, friendly creatures who hear you regain extra hit points when they spend Hit Dice; the extra healing is 1d6.
feature_details.Expertise: Choose proficient skills or tools; your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks using them.
feature_details.Font of Inspiration: You regain all expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a short or long rest.
feature_details.Countercharm: As an action, start a performance that grants nearby allies advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed until the performance ends.
feature_details.Magical Secrets: Learn spells from any class's spell list, subject to the bard's level restrictions.
feature_details.Superior Inspiration: If you roll initiative with no uses of Bardic Inspiration remaining, you regain one use.
feature_details.Divine Domain: Choose a divine domain that grants domain spells and features at specified cleric levels.
feature_details.Channel Divinity (1/rest): You can channel divine energy to fuel Channel Divinity options once between rests.
feature_details.Destroy Undead (CR 1/2): When an undead fails against your Turn Undead, it is destroyed if its challenge rating is 1/2 or lower.
feature_details.Divine Intervention: Call on your deity to intervene. Roll percentile dice; on a sufficiently low result the intervention succeeds, with success becoming automatic at 20th level.
feature_details.Improved Divine Intervention: Your Divine Intervention succeeds without a roll.
feature_details.Druidic: You know the secret language of druids and can leave hidden messages in natural surroundings.
feature_details.Wild Shape: As an action, magically assume the shape of a beast you've seen, using the Wild Shape rules and limits of your druid level.
feature_details.Timeless Body: You suffer none of the frailty of old age and can't be aged magically; you can also go without food and water longer.
feature_details.Beast Spells: You can cast many druid spells while in Wild Shape, providing material, somatic, and verbal components through the beast form as specified.
feature_details.Archdruid: You can use Wild Shape an unlimited number of times and ignore many verbal, somatic, and material components while in Wild Shape.
feature_details.Fighting Style: Choose a specialized martial fighting style that grants a permanent combat benefit.
feature_details.Second Wind: As a bonus action, regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level; once per short or long rest.
feature_details.Action Surge (1 use): Take one additional action on your turn; once per short or long rest.
feature_details.Action Surge (2 uses): You can use Action Surge twice between rests, but only once on the same turn.
feature_details.Indomitable (1 use): Reroll a failed saving throw; you must use the new roll. One use between long rests.
feature_details.Indomitable (2 uses): You have two uses of Indomitable between long rests.
feature_details.Indomitable (3 uses): You have three uses of Indomitable between long rests.
feature_details.Unarmored Movement: Your speed increases while you aren't wearing armor or wielding a shield.
feature_details.Ki: You gain ki points equal to your monk level, regained on a short or long rest, used for monk techniques.
feature_details.Martial Arts: Use Dexterity instead of Strength for monk weapons and unarmed strikes, use your martial arts die for damage, and make an unarmed strike as a bonus action after attacking.
feature_details.Deflect Missiles: Use your reaction to reduce ranged weapon damage; if reduced to 0, you can catch the missile and sometimes throw it back by spending ki.
feature_details.Slow Fall: Use your reaction to reduce falling damage by five times your monk level.
feature_details.Stunning Strike: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, spend 1 ki to force a Constitution save or stun the target until the end of your next turn.
feature_details.Evasion: On a successful Dexterity save against an effect for half damage, take no damage; on a failure, take half damage.
feature_details.Stillness of Mind: Use an action to end one effect causing you to be charmed or frightened.
feature_details.Purity of Body: You become immune to disease and poison damage and the poisoned condition.
feature_details.Diamond Soul: You gain proficiency in all saving throws and can spend ki to reroll a failed save.
feature_details.Perfect Self: When you roll initiative with no ki points remaining, regain 4 ki points.
feature_details.Divine Sense: Detect the location of celestials, fiends, and undead within 60 feet, subject to the feature's limits.
feature_details.Lay on Hands: A healing pool restores a total number of hit points equal to five times your paladin level and can cure one disease or neutralize one poison per 5 points of healing.
feature_details.Divine Smite: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, expend a spell slot to deal extra radiant damage.
feature_details.Aura of Protection: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet add your Charisma modifier to saving throws, while you are conscious.
feature_details.Aura of Courage: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet can't be frightened while you are conscious.
feature_details.Improved Divine Smite: Every melee weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage.
feature_details.Cleansing Touch: Use an action to end one spell on yourself or a willing creature by touch, a limited number of times per long rest.
feature_details.Favored Enemy: Choose favored enemy types; you gain benefits to tracking and recalling information about them and learn a related language.
feature_details.Natural Explorer: Choose a favored terrain; you gain exploration, travel, tracking, and survival benefits in it.
feature_details.Primeval Awareness: Expend a spell slot to sense whether certain creature types are present nearby, subject to the feature's limits.
feature_details.Land's Stride: Move through nonmagical difficult terrain without extra movement and pass through nonmagical plants without damage; you gain advantages against magically created plants.
feature_details.Hide in Plain Sight: Spend time creating camouflage to gain a bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks while motionless under the feature's conditions.
feature_details.Feral Senses: You gain an improved ability to perceive invisible creatures and can attack unseen creatures without disadvantage when you can otherwise perceive their presence.
feature_details.Foe Slayer: Once per turn, add your Wisdom modifier to an attack roll or damage roll against your favored enemy.
feature_details.Sneak Attack: Once per turn, deal extra damage when you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon and meet the feature's advantage or ally-adjacency conditions.
feature_details.Thieves' Cant: You know the secret language of rogues, including coded speech and hidden signs.
feature_details.Cunning Action: Take Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
feature_details.Uncanny Dodge: Use your reaction to halve the damage from an attack that hits you when you can see the attacker.
feature_details.Reliable Talent: Treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower on an ability check using a proficient skill or tool as a 10.
feature_details.Blindsense: If you can hear, you are aware of the location of hidden or invisible creatures within 10 feet.
feature_details.Slippery Mind: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.
feature_details.Elusive: No attack roll has advantage against you while you aren't incapacitated.
feature_details.Stroke of Luck: Turn a missed attack into a hit or treat a failed ability check as a 20; once used, recharge on a short or long rest.
feature_details.Font of Magic: Gain sorcery points that can be converted to spell slots and vice versa.
feature_details.Sorcery Points: You have sorcery points equal to your sorcerer level; they fuel Metamagic and flexible spell-slot creation.
feature_details.Metamagic: Choose options that modify how your spells are cast by spending sorcery points.
feature_details.Sorcerous Restoration: Regain 4 expended sorcery points when you finish a short rest.
feature_details.Pact Magic: Cast warlock spells using a small number of spell slots that recover on a short or long rest.
feature_details.Otherworldly Patron: Choose a patron that grants additional features and spells.
feature_details.Eldritch Invocations: Learn magical modifications and abilities fueled by your pact.
feature_details.Pact Boon: Choose Pact of the Chain, Pact of the Blade, or Pact of the Tome, granting a signature boon.
feature_details.Mystic Arcanum (6th level): Choose one 6th-level warlock spell as an arcanum you can cast once without a spell slot per long rest.
feature_details.Mystic Arcanum (7th level): Choose one 7th-level warlock spell as an arcanum you can cast once per long rest.
feature_details.Mystic Arcanum (8th level): Choose one 8th-level warlock spell as an arcanum you can cast once per long rest.
feature_details.Mystic Arcanum (9th level): Choose one 9th-level warlock spell as an arcanum you can cast once per long rest.
feature_details.Eldritch Master: Spend 1 minute entreating your patron to regain all expended Pact Magic spell slots; once per long rest.
feature_details.Arcane Recovery: Once per day during a short rest, recover expended spell slots with a combined level no greater than half your wizard level, rounded up.
feature_details.Spell Mastery: Choose a 1st-level and 2nd-level wizard spell that can be cast at their lowest level without using spell slots.
feature_details.Signature Spells: Choose two 3rd-level wizard spells as signature spells that can each be cast once without a spell slot per short or long rest.
